title: Data Pipelines: Extract, Load and Transform
description: Building a small data pipeline in Python: streaming CSV and JSON records with generators, loading them into PostgreSQL staging tables with psycopg and idempotent upserts, transforming in SQL after loading, validating and deduplicating records, enriching them with an AI model whose outputs are validated, and keeping sensitive data out of prompts.
sourceCoverageNotes: Covers S16 rows 0-3 and S17 rows 0-3; Fast FT10 rows 0-4 and FT11 rows 0 and 3 map here.

FT10 row 1 'Loading into a staging table with psycopg and upserts' is a wording variant of S16 row 2 and maps exactly to loading-into-a-staging-table-with-upserts. S16 row 1 (connecting-to-postgres-from-python-with-psycopg) has no Fast row, so the loading page is self-contained on the Fast route: its o1 teaches the minimum psycopg connection and with-block setup just in time, and its prerequisites omit the Standard-only connection topic (track-aware prerequisite note). On the Standard route the connection topic still comes first in topicOrder and deepens parameters and transactions. The module PR checks the Fast route starting without the connection page.
S17 row 3 'Reading: keeping sensitive data out of prompts' is the course's only Reading topic (kind reading, printable PDF); FT11 row 3 is its skim mapping.

Planned module lab python/data-pipelines/coding-lab (Standard lab overlay for Lab days S16-S17; Fast skips coding labs): one command, python -m pytest -q, against a learner-local PostgreSQL server with no container engine and a fake offline model client. moduleLabs lists it when the data-pipelines module PR authors it.
